filling: Good morning, Tom! How's the store looking this morning? Did you have a busy weekend?
Good morning, Jane! The store is looking good so far. We had a pretty busy weekend, lots of customers came in. How about you? Are you ready for the day?
I’m just about to start making breakfast and help the kids with their schoolwork. It’s going to be a busy day, but I’m looking forward to it. Do you need anything from the store before I start?

Thanks for asking, Jane! I don't need anything from the store right now. Just make sure to save me some breakfast! By the way, have you been following the news about the mayoral election? I'm really not a fan of Sam Moore.
I haven't been following it closely, but I've heard some mixed opinions about him. What don’t you like about Sam Moore? It seems like this election is getting pretty heated.

Well, I just feel like he hasn't done enough for our community. His policies seem more focused on big businesses than on helping local shops like ours. I really think we need someone who understands the needs of the small business owners. What do you think?

I can understand your concerns, Tom. It's important for our community to support local businesses. Maybe I should look into the candidates more before I form an opinion. Have you thought about attending any town hall meetings to voice your thoughts?

That's a great idea, Jane! I think attending a town hall meeting would be a good opportunity to hear from the candidates directly and share our concerns. I’d love for us to go together if you’re interested. It’s important for us to make our voices heard, especially for local businesses like ours. What do you think?
I’d love to go with you to the town hall meeting, Tom! It sounds like a great way to get involved and make our voices heard. Let’s check the schedule later today and see when the next one is.

That sounds perfect, Jane! I’m glad you’re on board. It’ll be great to discuss our concerns with the candidates directly. Let’s make sure we set aside some time to check the schedule later. Do you have anything else planned for today after the kids are settled?

After I help the kids with their schoolwork, I have some household chores to tackle and then I need to go grocery shopping. It might be a busy afternoon, but I should have some time to check that schedule with you. How about you? Do you have any plans after work?

I don't have any specific plans after work, just the usual closing up shop and then heading home for dinner. I’ll be looking forward to discussing the meeting schedule with you. If you finish your chores early, maybe we can even grab a bite together before I head to the store. What do you think?
That sounds like a great idea, Tom! I’d love to grab a bite together if I can finish my chores early. Let’s plan on it! I’ll make sure to keep an eye on the time. Enjoy your day at the store!
Thanks, Jane! I appreciate it. I’ll see you later then. Take care and good luck with the kids and chores!
